notes:
This is an early build, released to consoles set to Latest Updates.

Library views: Settings, Display and Sound, Appearance, Library view. Rolodex, Cover flow,
Carousel and Shelf show a console's games as 3D boxes; each box's spine carries its title in
the cover's own colours. The rolodex shows the game's play time, when it was added and your
RetroAchievements progress beside the box. With a 3D view on, the pre-launch menu shows the
game's box, and it flies there from the library when you pick the game.

The sort row above the games is gone. The left face button changes the sort (A to Z, Newly
added, Most played; Favorites also has its own order and By console), and the bottom bar
names the current one. Ports and Apps ends with an Add ports and apps tile, which opens the
picker.

PS2 patches for ARMSX2 games: each PS2 game's menu has a Patches page. It lists ARMSX2's own
patches for the game (widescreen, 60 fps and fixes, where it has them) to switch on one by
one, or your own: drop a .pnach file named SERIAL_CRC.pnach on the web page and it is used in
their place. A game lists its patches once you have played it with ARMSX2. Cheats also work
after one play now, with no save state needed.

Interface size: Settings, Display and Sound, Display, from 80 to 150 percent.

Headphones when docked: Settings, Display and Sound, Sound. With headphones in the console's
jack while docked, keep the sound on the TV, move it to the headphones, or play through both.
Not tried yet with headphones in a docked console.

GPU max clock: Settings, Performance, GPU Settings. Caps the GPU in every performance profile,
to save battery, without a restart. The CPU's Max clock is in CPU Settings.

Controller setup: holding any button for 5 seconds now always goes back a step, or quits on
the first step, even when the setup cannot read your stick.

Stremio's menus use less of the CPU, and the white frame around it is gone. Its pages are
still drawn by the CPU, so it is faster but not fast.

stable.notes:
The 2.41 changes, now on the Stable channel. If this console was on 2.40.0,
it also gets the whole 2.40 series, summed up at the end.

This update carries a new boot script: the console restarts once for the
update and once more on its own about a minute after the first boot. Do not
power off while it says part 2 of 2.

The SD card's fastest mode (DDR200) is now used on Samsung cards only, as
Switchroot does. Other cards run in the standard mode: if yours used the
fast mode, games load a little slower, but SanDisk cards, which cannot run
it reliably on the Switch, no longer get read errors under load. If a
Samsung card gives read errors, turn DDR200 off in the SCCM Retro app's Boot
settings.

The SCCM Retro app on the Homebrew menu is now one app: Launch SCCM Retro,
Launch in Safe Mode (stock clocks and voltages, once), Options (WiFi and
Bluetooth, boot settings, auto launch), and installing or removing SCCM
Retro on an SD card. The separate installer and calibration apps are
removed.

Swap A and B now applies only to Gen1Recomp and Moonlight, the two games
that offer it.

New background: Arcade, in Settings, Display and Sound, Appearance.

From 2.40.0, also: the console boots in about 28 seconds instead of about
50; Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask, and Mario Kart Wii as a native port
with Retro Rewind online, on Ports and Apps; a PC Games tab for Windows
games; auto save for RetroArch, 3DS and PS2 games; Wii U, GameCube, WiFi
and volume button fixes; and a security fix to install permissions.
